{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Totor's Party Kave''''' was a [[Sail barge/Legends|sail barge]], that was used as a floating nightclub on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].

==History==
During the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Korlana Toryn]] visited the ''Kave'', along with her [[E-3PO]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]]. The [[heroes of Cularin]] traveled there to meet with her, but the barge was then attacked by a group of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]], who hoped to collect a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] that had been posted on the heroes. The ''Kave'' then crashed, killing everyone aboard it, apart from Toryn and the heroes.
